tool_args.rationale: Fit the three parameters numerically using the verified siphon base and the open square-root completion. The wide parameter bounds allow rho to move beyond its warm-start interval. Fresh confirmation will test the resulting law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three parameters of the guided branch, and their gradient span is not narrowly collinear.
The supplied matched mechanism specifies a snapshot law at the target horizon; an additional trajectory is not needed to identify it.
The matched siphon subtree and monotone-concave signature support the specified square-root branch; the Haldane alternative predicts a high-input decline.
